<mxfile host="make-drawio-svg" type="device"><diagram id="page-1" name="One finite context window, assembled for a model call"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="350" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="heading" value="ONE MODEL CALL / FINITE CONTEXT" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="10" width="1060" height="50" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="instructions" value="Instructions
System + rules
For this request" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="95" width="250" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="catalog" value="Available tools
+ skill metadata
Host-selected" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebfb;strokeColor=#9b7ac3;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="290" y="95" width="250" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="working" value="Working context
Messages + reads
Retained by host" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff3db;strokeColor=#c59b4f;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="560" y="95" width="250" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="headroom" value="Headroom
Further work
+ response" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f4ec;strokeColor=#68a485;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="830" y="95" width="250" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="caption" value="Conceptual categories, not measured proportions.
History can be compacted; cached input still occupies context." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="260" width="1060" height="70" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: One finite context window, assembled for a model call
svg.desc: Instructions, exposed tools and skill metadata, and retained messages and reads share a finite context budget with response headroom. These conceptual categories are not measured token proportions. The host selects and compacts content; caching and billing are separate.

text.tspan: History can be compacted; cached input still occupies context.
